convert_perceiver_checkpoint: convert a Haiku Perceiver checkpoint pickle file to a PyTorch model for a specified architecture
rename_keys: rename Haiku checkpoint keys to match HuggingFace PyTorch Perceiver model state dict naming conventions
prepare_img: download a sample dalmatian image from Google Cloud Storage for model verification testing
build_perceiver_MLM: build a PerceiverForMaskedLM model and convert a Haiku MLM checkpoint to PyTorch with text masking
build_perceiver_image_classification: build a Perceiver image classification model and convert Haiku checkpoint to PyTorch for ImageNet
